Hi Laura,

Thanks for the intro earlier — Tom and I dug into the docs and we'd like to set up a focused technical deep-dive with our platform team to go over the Hosted API integration. Key areas we want to cover: SDKs (Python + Node), streaming behavior for live transcription, and how Redwood supports function/tool calling (we have a callout flow to trigger downstream Rx systems).

We're in PT and can do next Thursday or Friday afternoon PT. Can you confirm who from your side should join and send an agenda? We'll also want to share some sample payloads and a short deck on our end.

Best,

Head of Integrations
ScriptHealth

Hi Sonia — great to hear. Thanks for the clear list.

Suggested attendees from Redwood: me (solutions lead / API patterns), Karthik (runtime + SDKs), Ava (streaming / latency optimizations), and Marissa (CS / rollout planning).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 2026-02-12 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2026-02-12 13:00–14:00 PT
- Fri 2026-02-13 09:00–10:00 PT

Draft agenda (I can attach a PDF once you confirm a time):
1) 10m — Goals & success metrics
2) 25m — Hosted API patterns (request/response, streaming, token/cost implications)
3) 20m — SDK examples & best practices (Python/Node snippet walkthrough)
4) 20m — Function/tool-calling patterns + error handling (how to map your Rx trigger flow)
5) 10m — Rollout and next steps / action items

If you prefer an earlier or later time, tell me your constraints and we'll shift. I can also share a short runbook + sample payloads ahead of time.
